description: Upstream data and fake-server rules shared by every link-service implementation's conformance tests. Paths are relative to the repository's examples/ folder.

apds.GET /places: HierarchyElementList, pageSize 2, meta {referenceInstant:0, offset, pageSize, total}. Params: page, latitude, longitude, radius (metres, haversine R=6371008.8 to indicativePointLocation[0]; elements without a point are excluded when filtering), type (comma list), expand (ignored). Any other param -> 400.
apds.GET /rights/specs: RightSpecificationList, pageSize 2. Params: page. Any other param -> 400.
apds.GET /rights/assigned: AssignedRightList, pageSize 100. Params: right_spec (comma list; rightSpecification.id must be in it), credential_id (exact match on any rightHolder.credentials[].identifier.id), credential_type (comma list; the matching credential's type must be in it), page. Any other param -> 400.

matching: expect.body is a subset match: every expected object key must be present and match; arrays must have equal length and match element-wise; the string "<any>" matches any present value. Each case starts a fresh service instance.
